scope: reference-only; root must crop hair and preserve original pet face/ears/body

entries.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent illustrated game pet hairstyle sprite reference atlas.
Edit the referenced character atlas into a NEW 3 column by 2 row sheet. Exactly six equal cells, one full character centered identically per cell, comfortable empty transparent gutters. Top row FRONT, bottom row TRUE BACK of the corresponding hairstyle. Three columns LEFT acorn-bob (tiny softly curved acorn brown forehead fringe), MIDDLE cloud-bun (short natural fringe with one low, small rounded bun), RIGHT sea-braid (short natural fringe and two very short, fine braids ending above the chin, with tiny muted blue ties only). All hair warm chestnut brown.
This is the SAME animal, SAME original head, ears, round eye shape/position, original muzzle/body/paws/feet/proportions and soft furry storybook watercolor rendering. Preserve identity aggressively: no human face, no adult hairpiece, no giant hair volume. Hair must grow directly from its scalp, extremely close to round skull with tapered root strands mixing into the original fur and subtle matching skin/fur boundary. Expose BOTH original eyes fully and all original ear roots. Hair is modest fine animal fur-like hair, not a wig laid over the forehead. Forehead fringe stays short, above the eyes; no hanging curtain sideburns below cheek. Back hair follows natural skull curve, not a floating shape; real rear, no face on back.
No clothes, shoes, bag, hat, props, text, frames, ground shadow or background. Keep all cells fully transparent except actual fur and hair, genuine alpha. High fidelity to reference identity/pose. Desired atlas 1536 by 1280 with uniform cells.
Use ONLY reference atlas LEFT column original floppy-eared cream rabbit for all six cells: its left ear erect tilting slightly outward and right ear floppy angled down-right, EXACT original ear shapes and locations. Preserve its cream chubby head/body. Hair grows between and around original ear roots, with the ears clearly in front of the scalp hair; no alteration of ear angle. It is a tiny fluffy rabbit, not a human doll.
entries.review: Generated output inspected. Hair roots follow skull, original eyes exposed; compact lateral growth; true back shown. Generated facial microdetails and back rabbit ear coloring drift slightly, so ONLY hair area should be extracted and original anatomy retained. Exact integration fitting remains root responsibility.
